rules: Never reset the fixed native baseline silently; retain its exact image hash and source revision
Positive percentage is a reduction in cost: 100*(baseline-candidate)/baseline
Use paired same-input samples in one cohort; do not splice medians across runs
CPU, wall, RSS, allocated volume, compiler image size and generated image size are separate metrics
Exclude startup from the suite CPU geometric-mean score; disclose unchanged-code controls and regressions
Append qualified cohorts and retain raw samples; no hand-edited benchmark figures in README
primaryComparison: Original upstream Gleam CLI compilation: JavaScript output versus GTA native ELF
